name: jobs
title: Pathling Jobs Operation
description: This operation lists the asynchronous jobs held in the server's in-memory registry. When authorisation is enabled, only jobs owned by the authenticated caller are returned and the caller must hold the 'operation:jobs' authority; when authorisation is disabled, all jobs are returned. The operation is available only when asynchronous processing is enabled.

parameter.name: job
parameter.documentation: One entry per job, newest first.

part.name: id
part.documentation: The unique identifier of the job.

part.name: operation
part.documentation: The name of the operation that initiated the job.

part.name: status
part.documentation: The derived status of the job: in-progress, completed, failed or cancelled.

part.name: progress
part.documentation: The progress percentage (0-100), present only for in-progress jobs with known progress.

part.name: startTime
part.documentation: The time at which the job was started.

part.name: url
part.documentation: The absolute URL of the job's status-polling and cancellation endpoint.
